zone.name: In That Zone
zone.tagline: Maths first, then spelling and English: nine short learning games with a Controls box, a goal line and a Play Big Screen button on every page.

shelves.name: Maths
shelves.blurb: Sums you pick (+ − × ÷) at the tier you pick, from EASY (ages 5–6) to MAX MAX (ages 13+).

shelves.name: Spelling & English
shelves.blurb: Letters, words and rhymes, from 3-letter picture words to 9-letter spelling by ear.

games.title: Math Blast
games.tagline: Four numbered bubbles rise up the screen; pop the one that answers the sum before it floats off the top, with 60 seconds on the clock.
controls: Tap or click a bubble to pop it.
Keyboard: 1, 2, 3 and 4 pop the bubble in that lane, left to right.
Title screen: tap + − × ÷ to choose the kinds of sum and EASY to MAX MAX for the number range, then ▶ Start (60s). 🔊 top right mutes.
howToPlay: Score as many points as you can before the 60-second clock runs out; a correct pop is worth 10 × your combo.
Read the sum at the top (for example 5 + 3 = ?).
Pop the bubble showing the answer. A wrong pop resets the combo and circles the right bubble for a moment.
A numbered bubble that escapes off the top costs 2 seconds; ❄ bubbles freeze the others for 3 seconds and +5 bubbles add 5 seconds.
tips: Keep the combo going: every fifth pop in a row brings a cheer and the points keep stacking at 10 × combo.
Golden bubbles count towards a lifetime Gold rank shown on the title screen: Copper at 3, Silver at 12, Gold at 40.
Turn off the sum types you are not practising before you start; EASY adds numbers 1–9, MAX MAX adds 50–400.

games.title: Math Run
games.tagline: Run down a three-lane track and steer into the gate showing the answer; you have three hearts and a wrong gate costs one.
controls: Tap a lane, or swipe left and right, to change lane.
Keyboard: ← → or A and D move; Space or Enter starts, resumes and plays again.
Title screen: tap + − × ÷ for the kinds of sum and EASY to MAX MAX for the number range. 🔊 top right mutes.
howToPlay: Pass as many answer gates as you can before all three hearts are gone; each correct gate is +1 score.
Work out the sum shown at the top of the track.
Move into the lane whose gate shows the answer before the row reaches your runner.
A wrong gate costs a heart and highlights the right gate for a second; a 🛡 shield picked up on the track blocks one mistake, and gold gates drop 💎 gems.
tips: The track speeds up with your score and your streak (watch the Speed number in the HUD), so decide early rather than late.
Grab the 🛡 when it rolls down a lane: it absorbs the next wrong gate instead of a heart.
Gems bank across runs; with 3 in the bank a 💎 Revive button appears on the crash screen.

games.title: Math Snake
games.tagline: Snake on a 16 × 19 board with four numbers lying on the grid; eat the one that answers the sum and keep clear of the walls and your own tail.
controls: Swipe anywhere on the board to steer; on a touch screen there is also a ▲ ◀ ▼ ▶ pad at the bottom right.
Keyboard: arrow keys or W A S D steer. ⏸ (top right) pauses.
Title screen: tap + − × ÷ for the kinds of sum and EASY to MAX MAX for the number range.
howToPlay: Keep eating the right number for as long as your three hearts last; a correct bite is worth 10 × your streak (the streak counts up to ×5).
Read the sum at the top. Four numbers sit on the board and one of them is the answer.
Steer the snake onto the right number: it grows by one segment and a new sum appears.
A wrong number, a wall or your own tail costs a heart and puts the snake back at the left edge; four correct in a row starts a 10-second ⚡ Frenzy, and ★ gold orbs are +25 bonus.
tips: Miss the same sum twice and the right number gets a gold glow — follow the glow.
Wrong numbers wander to a new square after a while (14 s on EASY, 7 s on MAX MAX); the right one stays put.
Every fifth correct bite in a row gives a heart back when you are below three.

games.title: Math Battle
games.tagline: A monster fight where each right answer is a sword swing and each wrong one lets the monster hit you; a boss turns up every five kills.
controls: Tap or click one of the four answer buttons.
Keyboard: 1, 2, 3 and 4 pick an answer; Enter or Space starts, revives or starts a new run.
In the fight: 🛒 Shop, 🏆 Hunting Log and 🎖 War Medals open between swings. 🔊 top right mutes.
howToPlay: Defeat as many monsters as you can in one run before your HP reaches zero; the Best counts kills.
Tap the answer to the sum under the monster. A right answer hits for (5 + 2 per Sword + 2 per level) × your combo, and the combo climbs to ×3.
A wrong answer costs you HP, and the monster also swings on its own every few seconds (9 s on EASY, 3.5 s on MAX MAX).
Kills pay gold and XP. Open the Shop to buy a 🗡️ Sword (+2 damage), 🛡️ Shield (+10 HP) or 🧪 Potion (full heal); when you fall, Revive for 25 gold or start a New Run.
tips: Answer within 1.2 seconds to build a QUICK streak; 18% of hits are a CRIT for double damage.
Every fifth kill is a boss with 2.6 × HP whose special hits for double — drink a Potion before it arrives.
Your level, gold and gear are saved between visits, so the Shop upgrades carry over to the next run.

games.title: Word Scramble
games.tagline: A picture card is pinned to the chalkboard and its letters are jumbled on the desk; tap them into the slots to spell the word, five words a level across 15 levels.
controls: Tap a letter tile to drop it into the next empty slot; tap a placed tile to send it back to the tray.
Keyboard: type a letter to place it, Backspace takes the last one back, Space or Enter presses Play on the title.
Buttons under the tray: shuffle mixes the loose letters, 🔍 places the next letter as a hint, 🔊 says the word.
howToPlay: Spell every word in the level (5 words, or 6 on a boss level) to earn stars: 4 clean words give three stars, 2 give two.
Look at the picture and tap 🔊 to hear the word.
Tap the letters in order. On levels 1–6 a wrong letter wobbles back to the tray; from level 7 the whole word is checked when the last slot fills.
Finish the level for stars, new letter tiles and prizes, then climb the 15-level map.
tips: A clean word means no hint and no mistake — only clean words count towards stars.
Levels 1–3 are 3-letter words, 4–6 are four letters, and levels 13–15 reach 7–9 letters.
Stuck for 9 seconds and the next letter glows on its own.

games.title: Hangman
games.tagline: Five rounds per game: uncover the hidden word one letter at a time, because seven misses complete the drawing and lose the round.
controls: Tap letters on the on-screen keyboard, or type them on a real keyboard.
Round buttons: 💡 Hint reveals a letter for 15 points, 🌹 Reveal 1 spends a rose token, ⏭ Skip shows the word (no points), 🏠 Menu.
Title screen: pick a word length (Short, Medium, Long), then tap a category (🐾 Animals, 🍕 Food, ⚽ Sports, 💻 Tech) to start.
howToPlay: Score as high as you can over 5 rounds; a solved word pays 10 + 8 per unused miss + 5 per win-streak point (the streak counts up to 5).
Guess letters: hits fill the word, misses add a line to the drawing. Seven misses and the round is lost and the word is shown.
Words get longer with each round.
A round with no misses earns a 🌹 rose token you can spend later to reveal a letter for free.
tips: Start with vowels: the game's own hint nudges A, E, I, O, U before anything else.
One letter in each word is gold; if your very first guess lands on it you get +2.
Solve a word with zero misses to earn a rose token and progress towards the Perfectionist achievement.

games.title: Missing Letter
games.tagline: One letter has vanished from the word; pick it from four choices against a 60-second clock, with an emoji clue if you stall for 3 seconds.
controls: Tap or click one of the four letter buttons under the word.
Keyboard: 1, 2, 3, 4 pick a button, or type the letter itself.
Title screen: Climb (3 letters rising to 6), 3 letters, 5 letters or 6 letters, then ▶ Play or ♾ Endless mode. 🔊 top right mutes.
howToPlay: Fill as many gaps as you can before the 60 seconds run out; a correct letter is 10 × your multiplier, and the multiplier rises by one every 4 in a row.
Read the word with the ? in it and say it out loud.
Tap the letter that belongs in the gap. A wrong tap shows the right letter, resets the combo and costs 2 seconds.
After 3 seconds without an answer an emoji clue appears above the word; ♾ Endless mode swaps the clock for 3 ❤️ hearts.
tips: Answer within 2 seconds for a +5 slipstream bonus; one wrong answer forfeits the slipstream collected so far.
Three lightning answers in a run earn the 💨 SPEEDSTER medal; 10 words earn ⭐ WORD HERO; zero wrong earns 🎯 FLAWLESS.
In Climb, the words step up from 3 to 5 to 6 letters every 6 correct answers.

games.title: Spell & Say
games.tagline: Hear a word spoken aloud, type it letter by letter and press ✓ to check; three wrong spellings end the run.
controls: Tap letters on the on-screen keyboard; ⌫ deletes the last letter and ✓ checks the word.
Keyboard: type the letters, Backspace deletes, Enter checks.
🔊 repeats the word, 🐢 says it extra slowly, 💡 shows the next letter once per word for −5 points.
howToPlay: Spell as many words as you can on three hearts; a correct word is 10 points + 2 per streak point, up to +20.
Listen to the word. Tap 🔊 to hear it again or 🐢 for slow; if the device has no voice, the word flashes on screen for 1.5 seconds instead.
Fill every box, then tap ✓.
A wrong spelling turns the wrong boxes red, shows the right spelling, costs a heart and gives you the same word again.
tips: Check within 4.5 seconds of hearing the word for ⚡ FAST +3.
Each word spelled for the first time is +5 and joins your word count; five words from one set (animals, food, nature, things, body, royal) earn a badge.
Spell 8 in a row to win a heart back. Tiers unlock with XP: MEDIUM at LV 2, HARD at LV 4, INSANE at LV 6, MAX MAX at LV 9.

games.title: Rhyme Time
games.tagline: A word drops on the beat; type any word that rhymes with it before the bar at the top empties, no repeats allowed, three misses and the mic drops.
controls: Type your rhyme in the box, then tap 🎤 DROP or press Enter.
⏭ Pass skips the word but breaks your chain.
Title screen: Starter, Climb or Pro; the BPM slider (70–140) sets the built-in beat, or 🎵 Load your beat plays an audio file from your device. 🔊 top right mutes.
howToPlay: Chain rhymes for as many rounds as you can on three hearts; a hit is 10 points + up to 10 for speed + 3 per chain link (the chain counts up to 10).
Read the word, for example CAT, and type one that ends with the same sound, such as HAT or FLAT.
Hit DROP before the bar runs out: 14 seconds shrinking as the rounds go on, 18 seconds on Starter.
A word that does not rhyme, or running out of time, costs a heart and shows an example rhyme; a word you already used is refused.
tips: Drop with at least 80% of the bar left for ⚡ FAST +5.
Starter keeps to short words like CAT and SUN; Climb widens the pool at rounds 5 and 12; Pro mixes medium and long words like BUBBLE and ROCKET.
Above 110 BPM the built-in drums switch to a trap pattern with double-time hats; the time bar is the same at any BPM.
